newsitem.title: CHINA: Guangdong Kelon to place 76 mln new shrs.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Kelon to place 76 mln new shrs.

text.p: Guangdong Kelon Electrical Holdings Co Ltd said on Wednesday it had agreed to place through agents 76.598 million new H-shares at HK$9.20 each to raise HK$704.7 million before expenses.

The Chinese refrigerator maker said the issue would represent 16.67 percent of the company's enlarged share capital and that the shares would be placed to institutional and professional investors in Hong Kong and overseas.
The issue is arranged and underwritten by Peregrine Capital Ltd, it said.
The company said net proceeds of HK$680.1 million would be used to fund its expansion projects.
Of the proceeds, HK$65.36 million will be used to upgrade and renovate its research and development centre in Japan, and HK$224.09 million to strengthen its sales network in China.
It said another HK$354.81 million would be used to acquire or invest in several compressor and thermostat manufacturers, with the balance of HK$35.84 million for working capital.
Guangdong Kelon shares rose HK$0.40 to HK$10.75 on Tuesday.
